note: PHASE 11.3 -- two canaries that existed but that NOTHING RAN. Found while wiring check #62's self-test into CI and asking the obvious follow-up: which of the repo's canaries actually have a caller? Audited all five. check-sourcemap-debugids (phase 11), check-upcoming-event-cover (phase 11.2) and check-script-conventions run in a workflow. The other two did not: check:image-widths:self-test and check:plan-hygiene:self-test were package.json entries with ZERO invocations anywhere -- not in a workflow, not in the lint chain, not in pre-ship. A self-test nobody runs proves nothing, and is worse than none: it reads as coverage that is not there, which is the same lie in a different costume as a guard that reports green without measuring. check-image-widths' canary is 52 cases guarding the #178 incident (six blank organiser thumbnails on prod from a width vercel.json would 400) and it had sat unexecuted since the day it was written. It now runs immediately BEFORE the guard in architecture-guard.yml, so a broken guard reds on its own canary rather than reporting a pass it did not earn. check-plan-hygiene is the more interesting case and needed a judgement, not a copy-paste. Its GUARD cannot run in CI at all: the plans directory lives OUTSIDE the repo, which is why pre-ship is its only caller and why it appears in no workflow -- and pre-ship carries an explicit CHECK_SKIPS entry for exactly that. But the CANARY has no such dependency; it builds its fixtures in a tmpdir. So the canary alone is wired into CI, named in the step title as canary-only so nobody later mistakes it for the lint. That is the half of this guard CI can honestly own, and pretending otherwise would have been the overclaim this arc keeps finding. VERIFIED as CI will invoke them: 52/52 for image-widths, full pass for plan-hygiene, YAML re-parsed after the edit. THE GENERALISATION, and it belongs in the canary-ratchet arc: R4 asks whether a guard HAS a canary. It does not ask whether anything RUNS it. Two of the four pre-existing canaries -- half of them -- were dead on arrival, and the rule was blind to it by construction, in the same shape as the R1 blindness folded in phase 11.1. When the ratchet lands, it should assert a CALLER, not merely the presence of a --self-test.
